summary: AAP is a SAML service provider; before configuring it, set up the IdP (for example Entra ID Identifier/Entity ID and the Reply ACS URL generated by AAP), gather IdP attribute names and create a key and certificate with openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096.
questions: How do I set up SAML authentication in AAP?
How do I generate the SAML service provider certificate?
What do I configure in Entra ID for AAP SAML?
